ten_second.ground: The will has an orientation, toward God or away; call it its sign.
ten_second.question: Can a will turned away turn itself back by its own operations?
ten_second.break_it: Show one operation open to a fallen will that reverses its orientation. That breaks P-SIGN, and C8.1 falls with it.

sections.heading: The question
paragraphs: Every person faces somewhere. The old word for turning around is repentance, and the old puzzle is whether the turning is ours to start.
This paper defends a narrow answer.

paragraphs: The technical heart is an invariant. If every operation a person can perform preserves the sign, so does any sequence of them. Whether information-processing limits apply to persons the same way is still open:
